label: Assign unique setup-required credential hashes to existing employees

precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Employee" WHERE password IS NULL) AS result

execute.description: hash discarded high-entropy random secrets; never create default passwords
execute.sql:
UPDATE public."Employee"
            SET password = '!setup-required$sha256$' || encode(sha256(convert_to(
              gen_random_uuid()::text || gen_random_uuid()::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
            WHERE password IS NULL

postcheck.description: verify every employee has a credential value
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Employee" WHERE password IS NULL) AS result

label: Copy only unscoped assignment roles into Employee.roles

precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Employee" WHERE roles IS NULL) AS result

execute.description: copy distinct global roles; preserve every existing assignment
execute.sql:
UPDATE public."Employee" e SET roles = ARRAY(
            SELECT DISTINCT a.role FROM public."EmployeeAssignment" a
            WHERE a."employeeId" = e.id AND a."branchId" IS NULL
              AND a."programId" IS NULL AND a.region IS NULL
            ORDER BY a.role
          ) WHERE e.roles IS NULL

postcheck.description: verify every employee has a role array
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Employee" WHERE roles IS NULL) AS result
